findings.description: The reports bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so no customer-controlled encryption (SSE-KMS) is enforced for stored objects. Any report content is left relying only on the account default rather than an explicit, auditable encryption configuration, weakening protection for data at rest.

The ledger export bucket contains financial/ledger data but defines no server_side_encryption_configuration, so objects are not encrypted with an explicitly enforced key (SSE-KMS). Sensitive financial records stored here lack a controlled encryption-at-rest configuration.

The model artifacts bucket defines versioning and logging but no server_side_encryption_configuration, so stored model artifacts are not protected by an explicitly enforced encryption key (SSE-KMS) at rest.
The runbooks bucket enables versioning but has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so runbook contents are stored without an explicitly enforced encryption configuration at rest.
